lenses.name: Population
lenses.description: Modelled residents per km² of land: each country's World Bank population is placed on its hexes, concentrated around Natural Earth cities and on climatically suitable land.

lenses.name: People in the hex
lenses.description: The same population model, as a count per hex rather than a density.

lenses.name: GDP per person
lenses.description: Gross domestic product per resident (World Bank), current US$. All hexes of a country share its value.

lenses.name: Economy size
lenses.description: Gross domestic product (World Bank), current US$, the same on every hex of a country.

lenses.name: Urban share
lenses.description: Share of the country's people who live in cities (World Bank).

lenses.name: Life expectancy
lenses.description: Life expectancy at birth (World Bank), in years.

lenses.name: Electricity access
lenses.description: Share of people with access to electricity (World Bank).

lenses.name: Internet users
lenses.description: Share of people using the internet (World Bank).

lenses.name: Elevation
lenses.description: Mean elevation of the hex in metres, from the terrain tiles (SRTM/GEBCO).

lenses.name: Climate zone
lenses.description: Köppen-Geiger climate group: tropical, arid, temperate, continental or polar.

lenses.name: Distance to the sea
lenses.description: Straight-line distance from the hex to the nearest sea hex.

lenses.name: Cropland
lenses.description: Hexes the arable-land model picks out as cropland; the country totals are World Bank arable hectares.

lenses.name: Forest
lenses.description: Hexes whose Köppen climate carries forest: tropical rainforest, temperate and boreal forest.

lenses.name: Terrain roughness
lenses.description: Flat, hills, mountains or peaks, from the elevation spread inside the hex.

lenses.name: City population
lenses.description: Population of the cities whose centre falls in this hex (Natural Earth populated places).
